categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in the textile industry with vertically integrated production covering yarn processing, weaving, dyeing, finishing, and garment manufacturing. It focuses on producing high-quality functional and eco-friendly fabrics for outdoor, sports, casual wear, and industrial workwear markets. Key product lines include polyester and nylon fabrics, recycled and bio-based fibers, functional knitted and woven textiles, and specialized industrial and medical textiles.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced textile technologies including recycled polyester fibers, bio-based materials, carbon capture polyester, low-temperature dyeable polyester, and spandex-free mono-material solutions. It integrates smart manufacturing with IoT, MES, ERP, and AI-driven systems for efficient production and supply chain management. The firm also develops innovative finishing techniques such as water-based PU coatings, digital printing, and functional membrane laminations emphasizing sustainability and low environmental impact.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are international brand apparel manufacturers, especially in the outdoor, sports, and casual wear segments. The company serves major garment factories in Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Thailand, Sri Lanka) and some European and American markets. It targets brand clients seeking sustainable, high-performance textiles and collaborates closely to meet evolving environmental and functional requirements.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered and operates manufacturing facilities in Taiwan with significant sales and production presence in Southeast Asia, including Vietnam, Thailand, and Sri Lanka. It also serves customers in Europe and the Americas. The company leverages a global supply chain with a 4+1 layout (four fabric plants plus one garment factory) to provide flexible supply to both Eastern and Western hemispheres.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the midstream and downstream segments of the textile supply chain, encompassing yarn processing, fabric weaving, dyeing, finishing, and garment manufacturing. It maintains a vertically integrated production system from raw material processing to finished garments, enabling control over quality and sustainability throughout the supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing sustainability through ESG initiatives, developing recycled and bio-based materials, and achieving carbon neutrality by 2030. R&D focuses on innovative eco-friendly fibers, low-carbon manufacturing processes, and smart production technologies incorporating AI and IoT. The company emphasizes circular economy principles, product functionalization, and digital transformation to enhance competitiveness and supply chain resilience.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of textile products including fabrics, yarns, and finished garments. The company also offers integrated one-stop services combining fabric development and garment manufacturing. Revenue streams are driven by product sales to brand customers and garment manufacturers, with a focus on high-value, sustainable textile solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading sustainable textile supplier with strong vertical integration and innovation capabilities. It competes with other global textile manufacturers focusing on eco-friendly and functional fabrics. Its competitive advantages include advanced R&D, a comprehensive product portfolio, and a global supply chain network supporting major international brands.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$8.26 billion, a 5% increase from the previous year, but recorded a net loss of NT$278 million. Despite short-term losses, the company is focused on returning to profitability through revenue growth, cost control, and strategic investments in sustainability and digitalization. It maintains substantial assets and equity, with ongoing capital expenditures aimed at capacity expansion and energy efficiency improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself by offering vertically integrated, high-quality, and sustainable textile solutions tailored to brand customers' evolving needs. It emphasizes eco-innovation, including recycled and bio-based fibers, low-carbon manufacturing, and circular economy practices. Combined with smart manufacturing and digital supply chain integration, it delivers reliable, functional, and environmentally responsible products that align with global sustainability standards.
